BILLING.PENDING_EVENTS_HELP: They retry on their own every minute. If they are still here tomorrow, check the PM2 log ([TrainerBilling] warnings) and the webhook in Stripe.
BILLING.NO_CASES_DETAIL: No refunds, disputes or fraud warnings.
BILLING.REASON_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. annual refund within the 7 days
BILLING.REFUNDS_HELP: Refunds are made in Stripe (preferably from the invoice, with a credit note). Here you decide what happens to the subscription and the access.
BILLING.CONFIRM_SUFFIX: It will be recorded with your user and the reason.

PROBLEMS.FUTURE_DATE: The exception date must be in the future.

SUGGESTIONS.decide_end_or_keep: Full refund of the current period. If it was refunded to cancel, use “End service now”. If it was a duplicate or a compensation, keep the access and resolve the case.
SUGGESTIONS.revert_upgrade: Refund of a plan upgrade. To undo it use “Revert upgrade”: it goes back to the previous plan with no charge and respects the period already paid.
SUGGESTIONS.keep_access: Partial refund or refund of a past period: access is usually kept. Record the reason and resolve the case.
SUGGESTIONS.check_failed_refund: A refund failed: the money hasn’t gone back to the customer. Check it in Stripe and repeat it if appropriate.
SUGGESTIONS.respond_dispute: Open dispute: collection is paused and access is kept. Respond in Stripe before the deadline.
SUGGESTIONS.decide_collection: Dispute closed. Decide whether to resume collection (“Resume collection”) or cancel the renewal, and resolve the case.
SUGGESTIONS.review_fraud_warning: The bank warns of possible fraud. Consider refunding as fraud in Stripe and ending the service to avoid a dispute.
SUGGESTIONS.manual_review: It couldn’t be determined what the payment funded. Check it in Stripe before touching the access.

ACTION_HELP.resolve_case: Closes the case with your reason. It doesn’t move money or change the subscription or the access.
ACTION_HELP.end_service_now: Cancels the subscription in Stripe now, with no proration or final invoice. Paid access ends today and the data is kept. It refunds nothing: refunds are made in Stripe.
ACTION_HELP.cancel_renewal: The subscription won’t renew. Access is kept until the end of the paid period. It refunds nothing.
ACTION_HELP.resume_renewal: The subscription renews again at the end of the period.
ACTION_HELP.revert_upgrade: Goes back to the previous plan with no proration: nothing is charged or credited and the base period already paid is respected. Clients over the quota become read-only.
ACTION_HELP.grant_access: Grants paid access until the given date without faking a charge. It is recorded and can be lifted.
ACTION_HELP.restore_period_access: Restores the paid access of a period revoked by a lost dispute.
ACTION_HELP.pause_collection: Stripe stops collecting: new invoices stay as drafts and retries are paused. Access already paid doesn’t change.
ACTION_HELP.resume_collection: Stripe collects again: paused retries are resumed and the current period is charged. Past paused periods aren’t charged.

ERRORS.CASE_NOT_FOUND: The case doesn’t belong to this trainer.
ERRORS.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_FOUND: That access adjustment doesn’t exist or was already lifted.
ERRORS.NOT_REVERTIBLE: That upgrade is no longer the current one or changes the interval: check it in Stripe.
ERRORS.SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_ACTIVE: There is no current subscription to act on.
ERRORS.CASE_REQUIRED: Say which case is being resolved.
ERRORS.INVALID_UNTIL: The exception date must be in the future and at most 400 days away.
ERRORS.TRAINER_NOT_FOUND: There is no trainer with that email.
ERRORS.BILLING_BUSY: Another billing operation is in progress. Try again in a few seconds.
ERRORS.BILLING_UNAVAILABLE: Stripe couldn’t be reached. Try again.
ERRORS.BILLING_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The subscription needs a review in Stripe before acting.
ERRORS.CONTROL_REJECTED: Stripe didn’t accept the operation. The subscription hasn’t changed.
ERRORS.CHANGE_REJECTED: Stripe didn’t accept the change. The plan stays as it is.
